nom: First Aid Beauty Facial Radiance Pads with Glycolic + Lactic Acids

segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry, including several with eczema or dehydrated skin, mostly say the pads exfoliate without stripping moisture and even help smooth flaky patches, though one reviewer found it too harsh and drying for her dry face despite it working fine on her body.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, even those calling it 'temperamental,' report the pads exfoliate gently without stinging or redness, but a notable minority describe burning, itching, a rash, or breakouts, especially with frequent use or after a reported formula change.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say the pads feel refreshing and brightening without irritation, including one who uses them to clear dry, flaky patches that appear after showering.
segments.oily: The few reviewers with oily skin say the pads feel refreshing and brightening without drying or irritating their skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s or who describe aging skin say the pads restore brightness, even out tone, and support cell turnover without drying, and one uses them specifically for age-related changes rather than breakouts.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with aging or mature skin, including some in their 40s, say the pads restore brightness, even out skin tone, and support cell turnover, with one using them specifically for this purpose rather than for breakouts.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several who call their skin dry or dehydrated, say the pads exfoliate without stripping moisture and even help hydrate or smooth flaky patches; a smaller number, particularly with a newer formula, report the opposite, describing skin left red and dry 'like sandpaper' or too harsh to use on the face.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the pads don't cause or worsen redness, and one who does get mildly red at night reports it clears by morning; others, especially after a reported formula change, describe the pads themselves causing new redness or a burning reaction.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers caution that the pads are too harsh for a compromised barrier or for rosacea, and two describe a rash and a perioral dermatitis diagnosis after use; others say the gentle, pad-delivered acid lets them add exfoliation without feeling like they are risking their skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report the pads fade post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, dark marks, and acne scars, and one describes an evened-out tone with faded splotches after regular use over a few months.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with cystic or hormonal acne, report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and faster healing of the blemishes they do get; several others say the pads made an existing breakout much worse, caused a rash, or triggered new breakouts, in one case badly enough to limit use to once a week.

aspects.libelle: Recent reformulation removed key soothing ingredients
Pads are generously saturated, good value
Scent is noticeable and unpleasant to some
Pads hard to separate without tongs

extraits.texte: I tried this product since I was having a break out and it made it 10000x worse. I instantly developed a rash and now have perioral dermatitis from using this product. Which I am now on a long course of antibiotics to hopefully get rid of it. This product is disgusting!!! I have never had a reaction from a product like I have endured from this one. I would not recommend it!! I truly wish I never tried it. I hope my review can save your skin and prevent trips to the dermatologist like I have been dealing with since using it.

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive skin! Don't buy into the TikTok hype.
extraits.texte: These pads stung my skin a lot! I bought into the tiktok hype about these being gentle. Not true. If you have a compromised barrier or roseca/ sensitive skin this is too harsh. I didnt like the smell either. Way too expensive and drying for my skin. I cannot speak to their effectivness at exfoliaiton because I had to stop using them after a week. I switched to medicube zero pore pads and it doesnt sting/irritate my skin at all.

Normally with glycolic + lactic acid products I tend to be stripped of mositure, but these pads not only clean my skin, it removes any build up in the corners of my nose and just leaves it looking smoother and hydrated. I have dry sensitive skin, and have already stocked up since these are on sale! Totally worth if you're someone who loves investing in your skin and enjoys wearing make up especially. Literally leaves your skin smooth for make up + worked with all my other products!

I struggle with cystic hormonal acne and post inflammatory hyperpigmentation. These pads help keep my pores clean to reduce the acne and clear up the dark marks quicker. They are powerful but gentle enough to use daily. Love them.

I had been using Sunday Riley Good Genes and I love the product, just don't love the price. I started searching for an alternative and found these Facial Radiance Pads. OMG these things are awesome! I am in my 40s with aging and acne prone skin. I also have large pores, redness, and acne scars. I have been using these pads for a few weeks now and I have to say, they are a game changer for me. My skin definitely looks more radiant and is glowing! I am so happy to have found them and they are now a permanent addition to my skincare routine!

extraits.titre: Good for Dry and Sensitive skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First aid beauty has always been my go to for the facial exfoliating pads and exfoliating products in general. I don't know 100% if these are new or just repackaged versions of the ones they previously had, but I really like how they don't sting when using. I have dry sensitive skin, especially on my face, so I hate using anything that makes my redness worse or stings when using. This did neither of those. It didn't not make my redness any worse and it didn't sting my face, it did really exfoliate the dead skin cells and help the other products I use after make my skin feel smooth and hydrated. I like that it has both lactic and gylcolic acids in here, and doesn't just say aha or bha, and tells you which acid, rather than having to look it up. This also works wonders on KP. I have it on my legs and the backs of my arms and other places, so when I get out of the shower, I often use a pad on those areas before moisturizer, to help tame it. Definitely recommend these if you have dry sensitive skin.
100% recommend. works great for my oily yet aging skin. it doesn't dry my skin. I use once a day to exfoliate. no cons.
